_comment: Layer map for the dependency-rule gate. Seeded once by the architecture-gates pack; this file is yours to edit and is never overwritten. Rename the layers to match your tree — the gate only knows what is declared here. Files under root/ that belong to no declared layer are unchecked, which is how the composition root (main/index) stays free to wire everything together.
_mayImport: Directories this layer may import from. Anything not listed is a violation. Inner layers list fewer things; the innermost lists nothing.
_mayImportExternal: External packages this layer may import. "*" allows any, [] allows none, a list allows exactly those. An allow-list on purpose, so a package added later is blocked by default rather than passing unnoticed. node: builtins are always allowed.
